raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Long text-only chats on multimodal models waste API-process CPU and memory: each new turn decodes a prompt that nothing reads when the engine gets IDs.

Agent clients with long histories hit this on GLM-5.3-Flash, Qwen3.6-35B, MiniMax-M3 and Qwen3-VL-2B. Behind sgl-router, GLM-5.3-Flash and MiniMax-M3 text chats already arrive as IDs and skip this path.

On one B200 with Qwen3-VL-2B at 96.9K tokens and concurrency 16, QPS goes from 23.5-23.7 to 51.3-51.6 with `max_tokens=1` and from 15.5-15.7 to 20.6-21.0 with `max_tokens=32`. RSS growth over 160 prompts of about 116K tokens drops from 586-609 MB to 186-191 MB.

This is a test setup, not a cookbook deployment. The 2x gain appears only when the API process is the limit. Otherwise, expect about 10-20 ms saved per new turn at this size.

The chat template cache misses on each new turn and stores that text plus IDs as Python ints, which take most of each entry.

Open overlap: #30876 skips the same decode but predates this cache and conflicts with main. #46796 covers only requests with media, #27298 sends text-only requests as text, and #47028 caches encoding only (no combined run).

## Modifications

Text-only requests now decode only when sent as text (Responses, Moss-VL, tokenizers that add special tokens). The cache keeps their IDs as a compact array without text, so a resend still hits it. Media requests and engine input do not change.

A resend sent as text still decodes, about 20 ms at 112K tokens on Qwen3-VL-2B.

## Accuracy Tests

`96eb1d47bc` is the last head before I squashed this branch onto main `7b88f09239`. The squash kept the same diff, and I did not repeat these runs on it. On the squashed commit, only pre-commit and `test_serving_chat.py` ran, on CPU. Its only failures also occur on main in that environment, which lacks optional packages.

On one B200 against main `4ffc9e1b7d`, prompt IDs and temperature-0 output matched on Qwen3-VL-2B (sent as IDs) and LFM2.5-VL with cookbook backends (sent as text), for text, tools, `continue_final_message`, images, streaming, `/v1/tokenize`, Responses and Anthropic.

sgl-eval 0.1.3 gsm8k on Qwen3-VL-2B scored 0.815 on both with the same predicted answers (200 examples, temperature 0, seed 0, top_p 0.95, max_tokens 512).

The new test fails on main. `TestLlavaServer` and entrypoint unit modules found no regression.

Not checked: Moss-VL, mistral-common tokenizers on a server, a GLM-5.3-Flash server, sgl-router, real resend rates, and runtime CI (no `run-ci` label).

## Speed Tests and Profiling

 @dataclass
 class MessageProcessingResult:
-    prompt: str
+    # None: a text-only prompt on a multimodal model that was not decoded yet.
+    prompt: Optional[str]
     prompt_ids: Union[str, List[int]]
     image_data: Optional[Any]
     audio_data: Optional[Any]

@@ -5,6 +5,7 @@
 import logging
 import time
 import uuid
+from array import array
 from collections import OrderedDict
 from collections.abc import AsyncGenerator
 from enum import Enum
@@ -481,7 +482,7 @@ def __init__(
         self._template_reads_reasoning_content = (
             self._chat_template_reads_reasoning_content()
         )
-        self._chat_template_cache: OrderedDict[bytes, tuple[tuple[int, ...], str]] = (
+        self._chat_template_cache: OrderedDict[bytes, tuple[array, Optional[str]]] = (
             OrderedDict()
         )
         self._doc_splitter = ChatDocSplitter.for_model(
@@ -1266,7 +1267,13 @@ def _engine_prompt(
             and not chat_encoding.spec_renders_prompt_ids(self.chat_encoding_spec)
             and not prefers_prompt_ids
         ):
-            return "text", processed_messages.prompt
+            prompt = processed_messages.prompt
+            if prompt is None:
+                # A text-only request that is sent as text is decoded only here.
+                prompt = self.tokenizer_manager.tokenizer.decode(
+                    processed_messages.prompt_ids
+                )
+            return "text", prompt
         if isinstance(processed_messages.prompt_ids, str):
             return "text", processed_messages.prompt_ids
         return "input_ids", processed_messages.prompt_ids
@@ -2217,13 +2224,18 @@ def _apply_jinja_template(
                 if self._tokenizer_auto_adds_specials or add_special_tokens
                 else {}
             )
+            # Only a request with media needs the prompt text: the MM processor
+            # reads it. A text-only request is decoded later, and only if it is
+            # not sent as ids.
+            has_media = bool(image_data or video_data or audio_data or modalities)
             try:
                 prompt_ids, decoded_prompt = self._render_and_encode_chat_template(
                     openai_compatible_messages,
                     tools=tools,
                     template_kwargs=extra_template_kwargs,
                     encode_kwargs=encode_kwargs,
                     use_cache=is_multimodal,
+                    decode_prompt=has_media,
                     add_generation_prompt=add_generation_prompt is not False,
                 )
             except Exception:
@@ -2241,6 +2253,7 @@ def _apply_jinja_template(
                         template_kwargs=extra_template_kwargs,
                         encode_kwargs=encode_kwargs,
                         use_cache=is_multimodal,
+                        decode_prompt=has_media,
                         add_generation_prompt=add_generation_prompt is not False,
                     )
                 except _CHAT_TEMPLATE_CLIENT_ERRORS as template_error:
@@ -2257,12 +2270,14 @@ def _apply_jinja_template(
                 # The cached decode corresponds to prompt_ids before the prefix.
                 decoded_prompt = None
 
-            if is_multimodal:
+            if is_multimodal and has_media:
                 prompt = (
                     decoded_prompt
                     if decoded_prompt is not None
                     else self.tokenizer_manager.tokenizer.decode(prompt_ids)
                 )
+            elif is_multimodal:
+                prompt = None
 
         stop = request.stop
         image_data = image_data if image_data else None
@@ -2287,6 +2302,7 @@ def _render_and_encode_chat_template(
         template_kwargs: Dict[str, Any],
         encode_kwargs: Dict[str, Any],
         use_cache: bool,
+        decode_prompt: bool = True,
         add_generation_prompt: bool = True,
     ) -> tuple[List[int], Optional[str]]:
         cache_key = None
@@ -2356,12 +2372,16 @@ def _render_and_encode_chat_template(
                 )
         decoded_prompt = (
             self.tokenizer_manager.tokenizer.decode(prompt_ids)
-            if cache_key is not None
+            if cache_key is not None and decode_prompt
             else None
         )
 
         if cache_key is not None:
-            self._chat_template_cache[cache_key] = (tuple(prompt_ids), decoded_prompt)
+            # An array holds an ID in 4 bytes. A tuple of Python ints needs about 25.
+            self._chat_template_cache[cache_key] = (
+                array("i", prompt_ids),
+                decoded_prompt,
+            )
             if len(self._chat_template_cache) > _CHAT_TEMPLATE_CACHE_MAX_SIZE:
                 self._chat_template_cache.popitem(last=False)

@@ -1724,6 +1724,35 @@ def test_text_only_prompt_reuses_rendered_token_ids(self):
         self.assertEqual(adapted.input_ids, [11, 22, 33])
         self.assertIsNone(adapted.text)
 
+    def test_text_only_prompt_is_not_decoded_into_the_template_cache(self):
+        self.tm.model_config.is_multimodal = True
+        self.chat.chat_encoding_spec = None
+        self.template_manager.chat_template_name = None
+        self.template_manager.jinja_template_content_format = "string"
+        self.chat._tokenizer_auto_adds_specials = False
+        self.chat._prompt_text_round_trip_is_lossy = False
+        tokenizer = self.tm.tokenizer
+        tokenizer.apply_chat_template.side_effect = lambda messages, **_: "".join(
+            m["content"] for m in messages
+        )
+        tokenizer.encode.side_effect = lambda text, **_: [ord(c) for c in text]
+        tokenizer.decode.side_effect = lambda ids, **_: "".join(map(chr, ids))
+
+        adapted, _ = self.chat._convert_to_internal_request(self.basic_req)
+        self.assertEqual(adapted.input_ids, [ord(c) for c in "Hi?"])
+        tokenizer.decode.assert_not_called()
+
+        # A resend reuses the cached ids.
+        tokenizer.encode.reset_mock()
+        adapted, _ = self.chat._convert_to_internal_request(self.basic_req)
+        self.assertEqual(adapted.input_ids, [ord(c) for c in "Hi?"])
+        tokenizer.encode.assert_not_called()
+        tokenizer.decode.assert_not_called()
+
+        # The Responses API sends text on multimodal models, decoded on demand.
+        processed = self.chat._process_messages(self.basic_req, is_multimodal=True)
+        self.assertEqual(self.chat._engine_prompt(processed, True), ("text", "Hi?"))
+
     def test_prompt_reuse_keeps_media_path(self):
         self.tm.model_config.is_multimodal = True
         self.chat.chat_encoding_spec = None
